mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 3.0% signals inflationary pressure that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP (GDPC1) above 12-month moving averages signals synchronized economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) triggers persistent accommodative monetary policy that sustains equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above 12-month moving average signals robust consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS below 3.5% generates immediate positive market reaction in the 5-day horizon due to accommodative policy signaling.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) rising for 3 months signals sustained residential construction activity that drives economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST shows 3-month rising trend.
